title: Three Oil Supertankers Sail Through the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Two Chinese supertankers loaded with crude sailed through the Strait of Hormuz hours after a Greek vessel moved through the waterway, marking a significant uptick in oil shipping traffic days after a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran was announced. title: A Panicked Race for Barrels Is Gripping the Global Oil Market
summary: While investors focused on the fragile Iranian ceasefire this week, a desperate scramble for cargoes has been playing out in the oil market, as traders and refiners scour the globe for immediately available supplies. title: New Era For Space Dawns, As Artemis II Returns
summary: NASA's Artemis crew returned to Earth, splashing down in the Pacific Ocean and capping humanity's first return to the moon in more than 50 years.
